snippet.title: MIMESIS Teaser
snippet.description:
MIMESIS — Official Teaser Trailer 

The rain changed everything.
People began to act... differently — their voices, their movements, even their memories.
They were no longer human.

MIMESIS is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game
where you must uncover the truth behind a mysterious presence that mimics the living.
Caught between real and fake, truth and lies —
your judgment becomes your most powerful weapon.

Add MIMESIS to your Steam wishlist now: https://bit.ly/4hNwNDf
and board the tram... before the rain begins.
